headline: Casa Daia Bungalows / UNA Barbara e Valentim
context: In Barra dos Remédios, on the west coast of Ceará, four modular timber bungalows demonstrate that industrialized construction and high-quality architecture can coexist and respond precisely to an ecologically fragile territory.
